name: @jkos/scene
description: jkOS 3-D view primitive — hand-rolled WebGL2, no library. Layered like @jkos/player: /math (pure, worker-safe: mat4, solved springs, the orbit rig, gesture and picking math), /gl (WebGL2 + DOM plumbing: context lifecycle, programs, tokens), /react (useScene, useOrbitControls). A view brings its own shaders and renderer; this owns everything around them.
